source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: 5.1.1. Unaccusativity diagnostics in Sakha: Causative alternation and others
notes: Apart from causative alternation, unaccusatives can be detected using the following tests which all hinge upon the absence of Agent. As expected, they cannot be passivized (7a) while unergatives can (7b). An instrument role (which is only licensed in the presence of an overt or implicit agent) is disallowed with unaccusatives (8a) but may occur with agentive unergatives (8b).
en: The chair broke with a hammer.
